metadata.summary: Reject a malformed synthetic routing payload that caused repeated request retries.
metadata.requested_behavior: Malformed synthetic routing payloads fail once with a diagnosable error instead of retrying repeatedly.
metadata.release_trigger: Urgent maintenance after reproducible synthetic retry-loop evidence and targeted regression checks.
metadata.urgency_reason: The fictional retry loop consumes worker capacity and delays unrelated synthetic requests.

user_facing_behavior.before: A malformed synthetic request can enter repeated retries and delay unrelated requests.
user_facing_behavior.after: A malformed synthetic request fails once with a traceable error category for support.
user_facing_behavior.communications: Synthetic internal operations notice records the error category and escalation path.

known_limitations.description: The urgent synthetic fix rejects the malformed payload but does not redesign upstream payload validation.
known_limitations.mitigation: Retain diagnostic logging and open a separate upstream validation review.
known_limitations.follow_up_trigger: Review when the urgent maintenance change is stable in the synthetic rehearsal.

requirements.statement: Stop repeated retries for the reproduced malformed payload.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: The reproduced malformed payload fails once and emits the expected diagnostic category.

requirements.statement: Do not alter successful routing of well-formed synthetic requests.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Targeted synthetic regression cases for well-formed requests retain their previous outcomes.

acceptance_evidence.notes: Fictional reproduction and targeted check for the urgent-maintenance example.
Fictional targeted regression evidence; broader regression depth remains an explicit follow-up decision.

support_readiness.item: Operations can identify the new malformed-payload error category and escalation route.
Support has a concise distinction between malformed-request failure and unrelated routing errors.

documentation_updates.follow_up_trigger: Update the durable runbook during the explicit post-change review; until then use the synthetic triage note locator.

operational_needs.need: Observe retry counts and malformed-request errors after the synthetic change.
Confirm unrelated well-formed synthetic requests are not accumulating behind failed requests.

rollback_and_recovery.rollback_trigger: Well-formed synthetic requests begin failing or queue depth worsens after the change.
rollback_and_recovery.rollback_method: Restore the prior router build and temporarily isolate the reproduced malformed synthetic input.
rollback_and_recovery.data_recovery_notes: The example changes routing behavior only; no synthetic identity data migration is performed.

open_items.question: What durable upstream validation change, if any, should replace the narrow malformed-payload guard?
open_items.resolution_trigger: Address in the explicit post-change review after the urgent synthetic maintenance is stable.
